services.desc: Authentic Cuban food at Mallory Square, just steps from the cruise docks - no taxi required. For passengers disembarking and seeking a great restaurant near the Key West cruise port, El Mesón de Pepe is the perfect choice. Located just a short walk from the main cruise docks at Mallory Square, we offer an immediate immersion into the island's rich Cuban culture and culinary heritage. Don't waste time navigating far from the port-enjoy authentic Cuban food, refreshing drinks, and a lively atmosphere right where you dock. services.desc: With over 40 years of Cuban food, music, and family tradition, El Meson de Pepe is one of Key West’s last long-standing, family-owned and family-run restaurant businesses. We offer a private event setting filled with flavor, history, and Key West energy. Host Your Event with UsFinding a venue for your private party in Key West can be a challenge, especially if you need to entertain a large group. Many of the restaurants on the island are small with limited outdoor space. That is certainly not the case with El Meson de Pepe.
